{{Quote|I suspect Planore scammed you.''"<br />"''I was afraid of that. I knew I shouldn't have trusted him.|Meetra Surik and Kahranna|<ref name="KOTOR2" />}}
'''Planore''' was an individual who,<ref name="KOTOR2" /> in [[3951 BBY]],<ref name="CAMP">''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]''</ref> offered to arrange [[Transport/Legends|transport]] off the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] for the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Kahranna]] and her family. He charged Kahranna fifty [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] for a referral to his [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] friend, whom he claimed would take the family off world for 500 credits. However, Planore never came through with his offer of assistance.<ref name="KOTOR2" />

{{GameLSmechanics|Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords}}
During that time, Kahranna was forced to rely on<ref name="KOTOR2" /> [[Meetra Surik]]<ref name="REVAN">''[[The Old Republic: Revan]]''</ref>&mdash;a former [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] otherwise known as the Jedi Exile&mdash;for help. After hearing the Human's story, Surik expressed that Planore may have scammed her; Kahranna agreed, noting she should not have trusted him.<ref name="KOTOR2" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Planore was mentioned in the [[2004]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]'', developed by [[Obsidian Entertainment]].<ref name="KOTOR2" />
